attendance_correction_consistency.name: attendance_correction_consistency
attendance_correction_consistency.value: ("attendance_events"."kind" = 'correction') = ("attendance_events"."correction_of_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_events"."correction_reason" IS NOT NULL)

equipment_return_consistency.name: equipment_return_consistency
equipment_return_consistency.value: ("equipment_allocations"."returned_at" IS NULL AND "equipment_allocations"."returned_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "equipment_allocations"."return_condition" IS NULL) OR ("equipment_allocations"."returned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment_allocations"."returned_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "equipment_allocations"."return_condition" IS NOT NULL)

equipment_clothing_size.name: equipment_clothing_size
equipment_clothing_size.value: "equipment_items"."equipment_type" NOT IN ('tshirt', 'jumper') OR "equipment_items"."size" IS NOT NULL

mfa_totp_secret_required.name: mfa_totp_secret_required
mfa_totp_secret_required.value: "mfa_credentials"."method" <> 'totp' OR ("mfa_credentials"."secret_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_credentials"."key_version" IS NOT NULL)
